item.title: Tracker Status Update: New Orgs, a Change of Plans for the Pi, and an Indie Tracker Sibling
item.description: Two new orgs join the roster, the Raspberry Pi's original migration plan got scrapped in favor of something more interesting, and the indie tracker project is starting to take shape.
